tei:div.tei:p: na mo bi ga ta rā ga mai tre ya siṃ ha lo tsa ne swā hā/

gong bsnyen khri phrag brgyad de zhog re brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas pa'i sngags chu mig la byug na mig mi 'grib zhing gsal bar 'gyur ro// za yig phyogs bcu ma ni/ bhaḥnaḥdhaḥnaḥkuḥdhaḥnaḥyaḥdaḥnaḥ rgya shog la rgya snag gis bris la/ tshe sgrub dang bsrung bzlog la bdud rtsi chos sman dang*/ yang tshe sgrub la bzang drug /rgyal por gu gul/ klu la gla rtsi/ btsan la shu dag /gnyan la khyung lnga/ dug la rma bya'i sgro mdongs/ mtshon la padma rakta/ yams la spu nag sogs/ gnyen po so sor byugs nas yar la sgril/ gza' la spos dkar byug nas 'go nas mar dril lo// za yig spyi khyab rdzas ni chos sman no// de nas rab gnas ni/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ nam mkhar o rgyan yab yum bsgom/ gsol ba btab/ badzra gu ru bzlas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas o rgyan yab yum za yig la thim par bsgom/ gong du zhi drag gi snying po brgya rtsa dang*/ ye dharmas rab gnas kyang bya dgos/ za dus mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan bsgom/ gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing na sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs o rgyan la thim/ o rgyan 'od zhu za yig la thim/ mgo phyir dang 'phang sham bstan mid/ snying kha'i thad slebs gu ru drag por gyur/ sku las me 'bar nad gdon bsreg par bsgom/ tshe sgrub srung ba nyi ma rtse shar la bya/ gzhan rnams srod la bya'o/ ༈ / oṃ thi ma tha ra ti sa dun te dzwa la raṃ pa ye swā hā/ rang nyid phag tu bsgom nas sna bug g.yon du phus 'debs rims srung ngo*// oṃ padma sha wa ri phaṭa/ nan pa ta dpe gcig la ta la gi gu yod shig /na ga nan/ tadya thā/ sarba bi ri ta dpe gnyis la ta la gi gu yod/ ha na ha na badzra na/ rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā/ rims srung nad brgya sngags gcig 'di/ dpe khungs btsun bzhi la gtug nas bris pa yin/ gong bsnyen 'bum phrag gsum bzlas te/ du ba sna sgor ma song gong nyer gcig bzla la sna sgor phu btab bo// gza' dang dug dang rims la sngags chus phan/

spyir nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la phan/ phyi ma 'ja' lus thob par bshad/ mi la'i mig gi sngags ni/ oṃ lhang yul khang swā hā/ te ra wa la'i drug sngags ni/ hriṃ ni la ku la kha khra khra/ lo ras pa'i dug sngags ni/ bi sha 'ong*/ bhi ke bhun dzu/ bhi sha ke ro li 'ong*/ badzra bha bhi sha sa 'ong*/ ti ni bum pa na ra ka 'ong*/ i na ti ri ki ri/ mi na dhi ki ri/ saṃ pa lo sa no sa te/ a pa tsha long*/ saṃ pa na sa ta la/ bha swa ki tsa long*/ an tir tir tsa long*/ shi bhir a sho ri bhis/ gu ru la bhuddho/ ta ka ra/ gong bsnyen stong tsho gcig song ba dang*/ lto stong la bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas/ ha ka ra/ dbugs thengs re la thub tshad bzlas/ tho rangs bya skad ma chod pa gal che/ ༈ a spra'i sngags yin par khro lo lo/ thang chen po'i dbus su tsandan yal ga gsum gyi dbus su rang nyid lha mo'i cha byad rkang g.yas g.yon yal ga'i steng lha mo gnyis kyi gling bu 'bud pa bsgom/ des mthong ngo*/ ༈ /mu stegs rbad bzhi ma ni/ rang nyid dbang phyug chen po sku mdog dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas kyis rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ ya mchu la me/ ma mchu la rlung*/ ljags la me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ ral pa sa gzhi la khyab pa/ lto ba ngan sngags kyi rgya mtsho 'khyil bar bsgom la/ nag po rbad/ du na ya dpe gnyis la ya la 'greng po mi 'dug /dpe gnyis la ya la 'greng po 'dug rbad/ ma hā pañtsa rbad/ thun ril dza rbad/ gong bsnyen stong phrag drug de nas zhag rer nyer gcig re ma chag pa dam tshig go// gnyan lhog skrang rigs la sngags 'debs/ so srin la tshwa la sngags te so bar 'dzin/ tshwa srin la tshwa la btab te chu bkol dbul/ grang srin chu grang gis phul/ ya ma la ya khung du 'debs/ ling tog la phus 'debs yal ba bsam/ yang na pho rog sgro la btab mig chu nang du bltas la sgros byab bo// shu ba la mar rnying la btab nas byug nyi mar bsro/

rma 'bras la snum rnying par 'debs so// khrag chod la theb chen la sngags nas brlan no// rma la yang phan no// yang grog la btab nas brlan na rma phyogs med pa phan no// snum gang rigs nang ras bcos te khyi rma la blan na phan no// yang khyi spu la sngags khyi spu mer bsreg pa'i gzhob de ma thag rma la brlan/ de steng re ba nag pos bkab/ skud pa dkar pos rgya gram du bcing zhag gsum nas lta'o// lpags nad la sgyed pu gsum gyi dreg nag dang mar rnying zho sha rnying pa la bsres te sngags btab la nyi ma la bsreg go /grang gnyan la chang la btab khong du btang bas phan no// skyes pa'i dkar cha 'dzag pa la/ khyi nag po'i spu the gu gsum sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum rgyab la/ mdud pa re re la sngags stong tsho re 'debs/ sked par bcings pas chad do// 'gos nad bsrung na dri chu la btab lto stong la btang ngo*// thor pa srung na sran ma la btab ske la 'dog go mtshal dkar bkol ba la sngags khri tsho btab pa khong du btang na 'phral du bshal yong*/ yungs kar nang mar rnying la btab na byis pa thon no// yang rgyu gzer la sngags chu/ dmar nad la gla rtsi'i chu/ cham pa la gangs chur btab nas skar ma ma gyes gong btang*/ zho nyes la rde'u dkar nag la btab snod du blug go// gi waṃ la btab nas dpral bar thig le byas na dbang du 'gyur ro// de bzhin sindhu ras snying du sdug go /yungs kar la btab nas thun gyis brab na 'byung po kun bros so// thal chen dang yungs kar la btab nas gtor na ser ba thub bo// yang na rang dbang phyug chen po thal mdog /ral pa stong gsum khengs pa bsgom/ yul dang bsrung bya thams cad ral pa'i 'og tu mnan par bsams te sdigs mdzub byas pas thub bo// sor mo lnga la btab nas khu tshur bcang nas phyin na su'i rjes kyang zin no// ༈ a ṭe ba ṭe na ṭe ku na ṭe ṭa ke ṭha ke tha ra ke u ru ma ti ru ru ma ti ru ru hi li mi li sappa dzño du pa dagga na mo sappa sammā si budzdzñā ṇaṃ dzdzñantu me mant+ra pa dāḥswā hā/

sgra mi snyan gyi tshe gzungs so/ ༈ / oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇya dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i snying po'o/ ༈ /dbang po rtul ba'i rigs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lam bar gnang ba'i tshigs 'di gnyis/ rdul spang ngo*// dri ma spang ngo*// zhes brjod pas sngon tshig gcig mi shes kyang phyis mkhas pa dgra bcom pa chen por gyur pa'o/ ༈ /dam chos mthar phyin gyis/ stong nyid kyi ngang nas nā ga rakṣa'i sngags/ oṃ laṃ laṃ hūm̐/ rkyang ba bton pas klu gdon las grol ba yin gsungs so// oṃ mañdzu shrī ya manta kaḥ ha ya gṝ waḥ badzra pā ṇiḥ du tri ya ma ra tsaḥ ya ma rakṣaḥ kro dha sa tsa maḥ kā la ru paḥ a kro ra tsaḥ ya ma ra tsaḥ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la srungs shig nṛ bhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa rakṣaḥ ༈ zlog sngags ni: du tri ya ma ra tsaḥ ya ma rakṣaḥ kro ta pa tsa la tiḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha naḥ gnod byed byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bhyoḥbhyoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ dge'o/// /
